cases.EXE-01: Known engine.sum and engine.sha256 jobs must produce independently recomputable outputs; executed jobs must leave pending and have matching consumed tombstones and receipts.
cases.EXE-02: Unknown action, invalid payload, arithmetic overflow, excessive input, and expired jobs must become explicit dead letters without a success receipt; each failed key must be consumed exactly once.
cases.EXE-03: Replaying the same bound wave after restart must not execute a completed job again, duplicate receipts, or change ledger bytes; recovery after report-output failure must reconstruct the same report from persisted outcomes.
cases.EXE-04: A plan with changed job content or hash, a receipt with changed output or hash, and an execution report with changed result or hash must be rejected by Rust and/or the independent Python oracle as predeclared for each artifact.
cases.EXE-05: All newly consumed successes and dead letters, their outputs or failures, pending removals, and replay tombstones must be persisted in one LedgerSnapshot v4 atomic rename; old v3 snapshots must not be silently migrated.
cases.EXE-06: The previous binary has no execution mode and must leave all jobs pending; the new binary must show actual successful outputs and explicit dead letters under the same verified directive source.
